title: Maude design-system revision (system/<ds>/revisions/<id>.json), v1
description: An immutable, content-addressed freeze of a system's working files (V2-1.6 §5.6). The file name is the id: lowercase hex sha256 of the UTF-8 canonical body (keys sorted by UTF-16 code unit at every depth, no whitespace). Every files[k].sha256 is the sha256 of files[k].text. The body carries no time, author, parent or message. A future format is new files with a new v; this one is never rewritten.
